name: WA group invite
body: Hello {{customer}}, this is {{owner}} from HFMC. I have created our WhatsApp group for your home finance file {{caseNumber}} ({{amount}}). Please share your documents here so we can move to pre-approval quickly.

name: Doc list request
body: Hello {{customer}}, for file {{caseNumber}} please share: 1) Emirates ID (front+back) 2) Passport + visa 3) Salary certificate (latest) 4) 6-month bank statements 5) Latest payslip. PDFs only, fully legible.

name: Missing-docs nudge
body: Hello {{customer}}, a gentle reminder on file {{caseNumber}} — we are still missing a few documents and the bank cannot start without them. Please share them today so we stay on track.

name: Bank submission cover
subject: Submission — {{caseNumber}} {{customer}} — {{amount}}
body: Dear {{bank}} team, please find attached the complete file for {{customer}} ({{caseNumber}}, finance sought {{amount}}). All KYC/income documents verified against the checklist. Requesting pre-approval at the earliest.

name: Bank query chase
body: Hello, following up on file {{caseNumber}} ({{customer}}) submitted to {{bank}}. Please confirm receipt / review status and advise any queries so we can close pre-approval this week.

name: Pre-approval received (client)
body: Great news {{customer}} — your pre-approval for {{caseNumber}} is received from {{bank}}. Next step is valuation; we will initiate it now and confirm the inspection slot.

name: Valuation request (bank)
subject: Valuation request — {{caseNumber}} {{customer}}
body: Dear {{bank}} team, requesting valuation initiation for {{customer}} ({{caseNumber}}, {{amount}}). Property documents + payment proof attached; client in CC. Please confirm initiation and inspection date.

name: Inspection slot (client)
body: Hello {{customer}}, the valuer will visit for file {{caseNumber}}. Please confirm your availability and keep property access + title/MOU copies ready.

name: Valuation result (internal RE)
body: Valuation received for {{caseNumber}} ({{customer}}, {{bank}}). Report/amount shared with the Real Estate team and logged per protocol.

name: FOL conversion (banker)
subject: FOL conversion — {{caseNumber}} {{customer}}
body: Dear {{bank}} team, please convert to FOL for {{customer}} ({{caseNumber}}): finance {{amount}} — client has confirmed amount, tenor, rate, EMI and insurance. Pre-approval conditions enclosed.

name: FOL client call script
body: 1) Congratulate {{customer}}. 2) Explain loan {{amount}}, rate, tenor, EMI. 3) Explain total contribution (down payment + DLD/ADM fees + trustee + NOC + valuation + insurance + processing). 4) Confirm funds + preferred signing date for {{caseNumber}}.

name: Signing slot (client)
body: Hello {{customer}}, your FOL for {{caseNumber}} is verified. Please confirm your signing slot — carry original Passport + EID. We will confirm the venue and time.

name: DDA activation (client)
body: Hello {{customer}}, please activate the Direct Debit Authority for {{caseNumber}} so the bank can book and disburse the loan without delay.

name: Transfer-day coordination
subject: Transfer — {{caseNumber}} {{customer}} — date/time/venue + calculations
body: All parties please note transfer for {{customer}} ({{caseNumber}}, {{amount}}, {{bank}}): date, time, location and attendee list inside. Buyer calculations attached. Please confirm attendance with originals (Passport, EID, card, Manager's Cheque).

name: Settlement PRO exchange
subject: Settlement PRO details — {{caseNumber}}
body: Requesting PRO name + number from financing bank and seller's bank for {{caseNumber}} ({{customer}}). Settlement MC details enclosed; please confirm appointment and receipt on the day.

name: Manager's cheque request (client)
body: Hello {{customer}}, please prepare the Manager's Cheque for {{caseNumber}} (amount and seller name as advised) by blocking funds in your account, and show the seller's Emirates ID at your bank so the cheque reads correctly.

name: Transfer slot (client)
body: Hello {{customer}}, your transfer for {{caseNumber}} is scheduled. Please carry original Passport + EID + card + Manager's Cheque, and arrive 15 minutes early in proper dress (Abu Dhabi).
